#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 1e9;

int n, k;
vector<pair<int,int>> segs;

struct RMQ {
    int n, K;
    vector<vector<int>> minv;
    RMQ(vector<int>& a) {
        n = a.size();
        K = 31 - __builtin_clz(n);
        if (n & (n-1)) K++;
        minv.assign(K, vector<int>(n));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) minv[0][i] = a[i];
        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            int step = 1 << (i-1);
            for (int j = 0; j + step < n; j++) {
                minv[i][j] = min(minv[i-1][j], minv[i-1][j+step]);
            }
        }
    }
    int query(int l, int r) {
        int len = r - l + 1;
        int k = 31 - __builtin_clz(len);
        int step = 1 << k;
        return min(minv[k][l], minv[k][r - step + 1]);
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> n >> k;
    segs.resize(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        cin >> segs[i].first >> segs[i].second;
    }
    
    sort(segs.begin(), segs.end());
    
    vector<pair<int,int>> finSeg;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ) {
        int lo = segs[i].first, hi = segs[i].second;
        while (i < k && segs[i].first <= hi) {
            hi = max(hi, segs[i].second);
            i++;
        }
        finSeg.push_back({lo, hi});
    }
    
    k = finSeg.size();
    segs = finSeg;
    vector<int> l(k), delt(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        l[i] = segs[i].second - segs[i].first;
        delt[i] = (i < k-1) ? segs[i+1].first - segs[i].second : 2*n - segs[i].second;
    }
    
    vector<vector<int>> dp0(k+1, vector<int>(2*n+1, n));
    vector<vector<int>> dp1(k+1, vector<int>(2*n+1, n));
    dp0[k][n] = 0;
    dp1[k][n] = 0;
    
    RMQ rmq0(dp0[k]), rmq1(dp1[k]);
    
    for (int i = k-1; i >= 0; i--) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= 2*n; j++) {
            dp0[i][j] = dp0[i+1][j + l[i] + delt[i]];
            if (j + l[i] + delt[i] > 2*n) dp0[i][j] = n;
            
            dp1[i][j] = dp1[i+1][j];
            
            int r = min(j + l[i], 2*n);
            dp0[i][j] = min(dp0[i][j], 1 + rmq1.query(j, r));
            
            if (j + delt[i] <= 2*n) {
                int r2 = min(j + l[i] + delt[i], 2*n);
                dp1[i][j] = min(dp1[i][j], 1 + rmq0.query(j + delt[i], r2));
                dp0[i][j] = min(dp0[i][j], 2 + rmq0.query(j + delt[i], r2));
            }
            dp1[i][j] = min(dp1[i][j], 2 + rmq1.query(j, r));
        }
        rmq0 = RMQ(dp0[i]);
        rmq1 = RMQ(dp1[i]);
    }
    
    int ans = dp1[0][0];
    if (ans >= n) cout << "Hungry\n";
    else {
        cout << "Full\n";
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }
    
    return 0;
}
